title: 五木の子守唄 (Itsuki no Komoriuta — Lullaby of Itsuki Village)
description: A hauntingly beautiful lament from Kumamoto's Itsuki Village, sung by young girls sent away as live-in nursemaids from around age seven. They were permitted to return home only during Obon (mid-August). The song — 'I'm only here until Obon; if Obon comes early, I'll go home early' — expresses their longing in heartbreaking simplicity.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese folk song from Kumamoto, pre-Meiji era)
